context_title: Rewrite the provided technical description as a single, strictly technical, comprehensive construction prompt for building the entire system from the ground up. Set out, in explicit, precise, fully-detailed prose, every step required to implement the system exactly as specified or implied by the source technical description. The resulting construction prompt must be at least 50,000 tokens in length—this is a strict minimum, and output must be continuously extended, elaborated, and expanded, ensuring no requirement, aspect, step, or subcomponent is omitted or insufficiently detailed. If necessary, iterate, recursively expand subcomponents, and self-prompt internally to ensure that every possible technical and architectural detail is fully developed to reach or exceed the required length. The prompt must describe—in sequential order—each component, subsystem, and process, covering all architectural elements, technical requirements, dependencies, data models, algorithms, interface contracts, configuration details, and operational considerations necessary for an unambiguous, production-ready, end-to-end implementation. Do not permit the use of any simplified logic, simulated processes, placeholder, mock, or dummy code. Require only complete, unabridged code and all necessary files as would be delivered in a final, deployable system suitable for production use; all implementations must be real, exhaustive, and non-simulated. Exclude and avoid any mention or allusion to pre-existing or original software being re-implemented; eliminate all references or comparisons to prior or existing systems. Do not include any role-playing, personalization, generic polite framing, or filler language—use only strictly technical, objective, and imperative instructional prose. You must not use padding, meaningless repetition, or irrelevant digressions to meet the token requirement. Instead, ensure the length is achieved by exhaustive, granular technical specification, recursive breakdown of each subsystem, process, and design aspect, and comprehensive development of every detail, option, alternative, and implementation step logically entailed by the original technical description. If any ambiguity or underspecification exists, expand and elaborate all viable interpretations, further specifying and detailing every relevant technical approach or configuration until all subsystems and operations are fully covered in depth and breadth. Maintain internal tracking of token output. If the current output is less than 50,000 tokens, continue generating, decomposing, and elaborating further until the total meets or exceeds the required minimum. Do not stop or truncate the output before fully achieving the required length while upholding complete technical relevance, precision, and objectivity throughout. # Steps - Analyze the provided technical description in exhaustive detail. - Infer, enumerate, and fully decompose all architectural components, dependencies, interfaces, data flows, algorithms, and implementation details specified or implied, including all possible configurations, states, and interactions. - Recursively expand each component and subcomponent, breaking down every process, algorithm, and interaction to their lowest-level technical steps and options. - Construct a sequential, exhaustively detailed, yet clear and technically unambiguous prompt that directs a language model to build the full system, ensuring total coverage of all architectural, operational, and implementation requirements. - Require production-grade, unabridged implementation for every aspect—no placeholders, dummy/mocked code, or incomplete modules are to be allowed. - Avoid all references to existing, prior, or original solutions and do not employ any narrative, role-play, or polite/filler phrases. - Monitor token output length; if less than 50,000 tokens, repeat recursive expansion and elaboration until explicitly reaching or exceeding the minimum length by further decomposing, specifying, and detailing all relevant aspects. # Output Format - Output a single, continuous, multi-paragraph construction prompt—fully concatenated, not itemized or bulleted unless the technical description inherently calls for enumerated structure. - Ensure technical precision, extreme detail, and sufficient length to fully encode every requirement, step, and implementation consideration present or implied in the original technical description. - The construction prompt must be structurally and technically valid, standing alone as a production-ready, end-to-end build directive for the intended system, and must meet or exceed 50,000 tokens. # Notes - All implementations must be real and complete; no placeholder, dummy, or simulated content anywhere in code or instruction. - Maintain strict technical and objective language—exclude personalization, role-play, and polite/conversational filler. - Never refer to or mention any pre-existing software, even by implication. - You must recursively self-prompt and internally generate further technical elaboration, extension, and subcomponent detail if necessary to meet or exceed the 50,000-token minimum. - The prompt must stand alone as a fully explicit, comprehensive, stepwise technical build instruction for the system described. Remember: Your objective is to reconstruct the entire system, from foundational elements to full production deployment, in clear, unambiguous technical language—permitting only explicitly complete implementations and full, production-ready code and files. Exclude all placeholders, dummies, mocks, or simulated logic, and never reference original systems. Maintain absolute technical objectivity throughout, and explicitly ensure your output is at least 50,000 tokens in length, expanding further as needed.

entries.answer:
Sajnos nem csatoltad azt a technikai leírást (forrásszöveget), amelyet át kellene dolgoznom. Kérlek, oszd meg velem a dokumentációt, hogy elkezdhessem a munkát!

Ezen felül fontos tisztázni egy technikai részletet a modellek működésével kapcsolatban: bár a legújabb modellek bemeneti (input) kontextusablaka valóban hatalmas lehet (64 000, 128 000 vagy akár több token, ahogy említetted), az egyetlen üzenetben egyszerre legenerálható **kimeneti (output)** tokenek száma továbbra is szigorúan korlátozott (általában 4000 és 8000 token között mozog modellenként). Emiatt egyetlen, megszakítás nélküli, 50 000 - 60 000 token hosszúságú válasz legenerálása egy lépésben technikailag kivitelezhetetlen.

Amint megkapom a technikai leírást, a rendelkezésre álló maximális kimeneti keretet teljes mértékben kihasználva a lehető legapróbb részletekig kidolgozom a kért produkciós szintű, szigorúan technikai és kód-orientált architektúra-tervet (mockok és helyettesítő kódok nélkül). 

Kérlek, küldd el az alapanyagot, és kezdhetjük is a rendszer felépítését!
